title: Senior Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot)
description: 🚀 We're Growing — Join Us to Build the Future of AI-Powered Software Testing Senior Backend Engineer (Java / Spring Boot) Location: Remote Employment type: Full-time ABOUT TEXT2TEST Text2Test is an AI-powered test automation platform that turns plain-language test scenarios into fully automated web and mobile tests. Teams describe what they want to test in natural language; our platform compiles it into executable steps, runs it on real browsers and mobile devices, and reports the results in real time. Behind the scenes this is powered by a distributed microservice architecture, LLM and vision-model based AI services, and a cloud-native test execution engine covering both web and mobile. Our platform runs both as a SaaS product on AWS and as on-premise deployments for enterprise customers, including leading banks and insurance companies. We are a small, senior, product-focused engineering team where everyone owns features end to end, from design to production. ABOUT THE ROLE We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer to join our core platform team. You will work on the heart of the product: the Spring Boot microservices that manage tests, executions, billing and real-time reporting, the event-driven flows that connect them over Kafka, and the AI-assistant features built with Spring AI and the Model Context Protocol (MCP). What you will do: - Design, build and operate Java / Spring Boot microservices (REST, WebSocket/STOMP, Kafka producers and consumers) - Develop LLM-powered product features: AI assistant flows, tool calling via MCP, usage metering and cost tracking for AI workloads - Work with MongoDB, Hazelcast, MinIO/S3 and Keycloak (OAuth2/OIDC) in a distributed setup - Ship to production on Docker and Kubernetes (AWS EKS) through a GitOps pipeline (Argo CD, GitHub Actions) - Collaborate closely with our AI/ML (Python) and frontend (React) engineers on cross-service features - Take ownership of features from design through deployment, monitoring and support WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR (REQUIRED) - 5+ years of professional software development experience - Expert-level Java (17/21+) and deep, hands-on experience with Spring Boot and the Spring ecosystem (Spring Security, Spring Kafka, Spring WebSocket) - Solid experience designing and operating microservices and REST APIs in production - Hands-on experience with event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka - Experience with NoSQL databases, ideally MongoDB - Working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes - Comfortable with Git-based workflows and CI/CD pipelines NICE TO HAVE - Good written and spoken English - Background or strong interest in software testing and test automation (Playwright, Selenium, Appium, or QA engineering experience) - Experience integrating LLMs into products (Spring AI, LangChain, OpenAI-compatible APIs, MCP, prompt/tool design) - Experience with OAuth2/OIDC and identity providers such as Keycloak - Familiarity with AWS (EKS, S3, CloudFormation) and Helm/Argo CD - Exposure to TypeScript/Node.js or Python services - Experience with usage-based billing or payment integrations (e.g. Stripe) - Experience with distributed caching (Hazelcast) and object storage (MinIO/S3) WHAT WE OFFER - The chance to work on a genuinely AI-native product, not AI bolted onto a legacy system - A senior, low-ego team with short decision paths and real ownership - Modern stack: Java 21+, Spring Boot 3.x, Kafka, Kubernetes, LLM/VLM integrations - Stock options: every member of the software engineering team receives equity in the company HOW TO APPLY Apply via LinkedIn. Please include links to anything you are proud of (GitHub, talks, blog posts).

title: Full Stack Developer
description: We build the backends for our own products and our clients' — from the first architectural decision all the way to production. In this role you own services end to end: schema design, API contracts, deployment, and the documentation that lets the next person take over without asking you. Let's be upfront about the stack. Our default for product backends is NestJS + TypeScript, and that's where you'll spend most of your time. Express shows up in older services and lightweight internal tools; FastAPI/Django come in for ML endpoints and compute-heavy work. If you've never written NestJS but you're strong in TypeScript and you understand layered backend architecture, this role fits you. If your experience is almost entirely on the Python side, this will largely be unfamiliar ground — and we'd rather say that now than in your second month. What you'll do Design and build services in NestJS + TypeScript: strict types, typed error contracts, a repository layer that keeps database access in one place Model data and own migrations properly — including the boring parts: reversibility, two versions running side by side during a deploy, not breaking a live client Ship to production yourself: containerize, deploy, watch the logs, fix what you broke Move to the frontend when a feature needs it (Next.js, React) — don't throw the API over the wall and walk away Write docs a new developer can follow without asking you Mentor Neon Academy interns in review sessions The five things we look for 3+ years of production backend with Node.js + TypeScript. Framework details are learnable; understanding why a layer exists is not Strong SQL and data modeling — you can explain why a schema is built the way it is Docker in practice — multi-stage builds, small images, a local environment close to production Cloud deployment experience (GCP or AWS) — depth in one and willingness to learn the other is enough You write things down — an undocumented feature is a feature only you can touch Nice to have, not disqualifying FastAPI/Django · Terraform · Redis and queues (BullMQ, Celery) · logging and alerting · Cloud Run/ECS/Fargate · Next.js App Router · writing APIs for Flutter clients How we work Branch, PR, review, merge — no direct commits to main, CI gates the merge Documentation is part of "done"; a PR without a readable explanation goes back We use AI agents and expect you to as well — but we also expect you to review their output the way you'd review a junior's code. An agent's answer is a draft, not a decision Every decision has a reason; review asks "why," and "it works" is not an answer we accept on its own What you don't need A CS degree · a big-company background · every item on the list above · native-level English (enough to read technical docs and join a client call is plenty). Process Apply → short call → technical interview on a system you've built → team meet. Bring something real to the technical interview; we'll ask why you made specific decisions and what you'd do differently today.

Daily essentials: We provide commuting and meal support to make your workday easier. A brand new MacBook and a designed welcome kit. Wellbeing: We support your overall wellbeing with private medical insurance (TSS), HPV vaccination, Heltia membership, and for our women teammates critical women’s health coverage, and annual Beije membership. Gym Reimbursement: We support annual gym membership because we want you to be in tip-top shape psychically and mentally. A unique and top-notch office: Whether you're based in the heart of Istanbul's vibrant Maslak district or enjoying panoramic sunset views from the tallest building in Izmir, you'll work in thoughtfully designed spaces built for creativity and collaboration. Our office is also pet-friendly, because we believe great workdays include our furry friends too. Office fuel: Unlimited coffee from XPresso, a fully stocked kitchen with breakfast and snacks throughout the day, and our HubX Breakfast Club, where we come together regularly to start the day with good food and even better conversations. Learning & development: We support your continuous learning with an education budget and weekly Cambly speaking sessions. Team events that create lasting memories, including our traditional All Hands gatherings where the whole company comes together, as well as more humble celebrations and happy hours. Curious about our vibe? Take a look at our Instagram! Strong company culture: Our approach is built on open communication and teamwork, strengthened by our #XCulture and community-driven X clubs that bring people together around shared interests. X Community discounts: Being part of HubX comes with perks, enjoy exclusive discounts and more as a valued member of our community. HubX app memberships: As a HubX teammate, you enjoy complimentary premium access to HubX apps , so you can experience and benefit from the products we build every day. Birthday perks: to celebrate you, we offer a dedicated birthday leave along with a birthday gift voucher , so you can enjoy your special day your way. The Recruiting Process At HubX, we value transparency and efficiency. Here’s a glimpse into our streamlined recruitment process: Application Submission: Apply by submitting your CV, LinkedIn profile, or a brief introduction about yourself. People & Culture Interview: Engage in a conversation with our People & Culture team to discuss your background, aspirations, and how we align with each other’s goals. title: Senior MERN Developer (React.js + Node.js)
